textures.name: sea
textures.prompt:
Close-up photograph, straight on and flat, of old smooth cream parchment
with faint light tan stains, even and uniform, low contrast, no writing,
filling the whole image.

textures.name: land
textures.prompt:
Close-up photograph, straight on and flat, of old parchment covered all
over with a fine even stipple of tiny dots of brown ink, uniform in
every direction, no lines, no bands, low contrast, filling the whole
image.

textures.name: sand
textures.prompt:
Close-up photograph, straight on and flat, of old parchment washed with
a light brown ink stain, even and uniform, low contrast, filling the
whole image.

textures.name: town
textures.prompt:
A small solid drawing of a single house with a pitched roof, a door and
two windows, filled in dark brown ink, its windows and door left pale,
on a plain light grey ground, like a town on an old map, nothing else.
